title: Same-agent localization with and without ARCHMELD
question: Does the same agent localize and explain a small repository more accurately, request less human-supplied information, or make fewer unsupported conclusions when ARCHMELD is available than when it is not?

protocol.design: One paired run. Both arms received the identical task text and JSON output schema; only the permitted evidence tooling differed. Both were read-only, and no human was available during the run, so explicit unresolved information items (info_requests) are the operational proxy for human supplements.

agent.model: same session model for both arms (opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash)
agent.launch: two subagents launched in parallel by the host Agent tool

fixture.uncommitted_change: src/change.py line 2, apply_discount, return value * 0.9 -> value * 0.8

questions: Q1: locate the assignment of 'E_UNIQUE_7F3', its line, enclosing function and def line
Q2: report late_target's returned computation expression and line
Q3: find compute_metric's caller with file and call line
Q4: identify the single uncommitted change, old/new expression, enclosing function, and its caller with file and call line
task.response_format: strict JSON with localizations, conclusions + evidence refs, info_requests and uncertainties

A_no_archmeld.permitted: read-only rg/grep/sed/awk/find/git/python and file reads inside the repository
A_no_archmeld.prohibited: ARCHMELD binaries, MCP, loopback HTTP, and the state directory

B_with_archmeld.permitted: ARCHMELD HTTP status/review/query/source as primary evidence, plus read-only file inspection for confirmation
B_with_archmeld.endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:6778 (loopback, --no-auth, no token issued or logged)
B_with_archmeld.prohibited: direct reads or writes of the state directory

server_log.note: The only line is the announcement with token:null and the workspace handle.

api_preflight.status: GET /v1/status returned the project, freshness and 15/15 counts
api_preflight.review_workspace_diff: POST /v1/reviews/workspace-diff returned the affected src/change.py entity and the static_call_candidate edge from checkout to apply_discount
api_preflight.source_search: POST /v1/query kind=source for E_UNIQUE_7F3 returned exactly 2 matches: src/late.py line 240 (comment) and line 242 (assignment), with the entity id attached to line 242
api_preflight.impact: POST /v1/query kind=impact from compute_metric returned run_report via a static_call_candidate edge with resolution=candidate, not a resolved call

manual_grading.method: Each conclusion was checked against the cited file lines and independently against the preflight API responses. A conclusion is unsupported if its cited evidence is absent, out of range, or does not establish the stated claim.

C1.basis: src/late.py lines 240/241/242; rg confirms exactly two occurrences

C2.basis: src/late.py lines 242/243/244; marker is assigned but not read by the return

C3.basis: src/metrics.py line 1, src/report.py lines 1 and 4; rg confirms one call site

C4.basis: git diff shows one hunk at src/change.py line 2; src/checkout.py lines 1 and 4 show the sole caller

C1.basis: src/late.py lines 240/242; matches the API source search

C2.basis: src/late.py lines 243/244; matches the snapshot bytes

C3.basis: src/report.py line 4 and src/metrics.py line 1; the candidate-vs-resolved distinction matches the API impact response

C4.basis: src/change.py lines 1/2; live bytes and base snapshot agree with the workspace-diff response

verdict.summary: Both arms reached 17/17 localization fields and 4/4 fully correct tasks, made 0 info requests, and had 0 unsupported conclusions. No accuracy or information-request difference was observed on this fixture.
verdict.qualitative_difference: The ARCHMELD arm explicitly labeled the run_report -> compute_metric edge as a static_call_candidate with resolution=candidate rather than a resolved call. The baseline arm reported the source-level call correctly but did not carry that resolution label. This is a precision difference, not an accuracy difference.
verdict.cost: The ARCHMELD arm used 14 versus 9 tool calls (+5), 229,400 versus 140,449 tokens (+63%), and 66.7 versus 39.0 seconds (+71%) on this 7-file fixture.
verdict.claim_boundary: This is a single paired run on a small, deterministic fixture with a ceiling effect. It closes the previously recorded 'no same-agent comparison experiment was run' gap and records a null accuracy result; it is not a statistically powered benchmark and must not be used to claim an accuracy or productivity advantage for ARCHMELD.

fixture_archive.note: Copies of the 7-file working tree plus base/change.py and live.patch; file digests match the origin repository.

commands.state: background process; announcement captured, still serving during the run

commands.purpose: verify status, workspace diff, source search and impact queries
commands.note: four loopback requests; responses are summarized under api_preflight
identical task text and schema; only the tool-condition paragraph differed

limitations: Single paired run; no repeated trials or confidence interval.
Seven-file fixture with a deterministic answer; both arms hit the 17/17 ceiling, so the experiment cannot distinguish accuracy on harder repositories.
Agent tool-use counts, token counts and durations are host-reported usage, not an independent shell audit; final JSON outputs were machine-parsed and their evidence references were range-checked.
The ARCHMELD arm's advantage in resolution labeling is qualitative and was not separately scored as a localization field.
No human was present; info_requests is a proxy for human information supplements, not a count of actual human interventions.
The live src/change.py edit was made by the experimenter before the run; the agents made no repository changes.

reproduction.fixture: Apply docs/evidence/agent-comparison-2026-11-03/fixture/live.patch to the archived fixture, or use the archived working tree directly.
reproduction.index: The original index used the packaged archmeld-index helper over the snapshot; the project/snapshot ids, manifest digest and file digests are recorded above.
reproduction.preflight: Run the four loopback requests summarized under api_preflight; the source search must return exactly lines 240 and 242.
reproduction.agents: Send the common block in prompts.md plus the matching TOOL CONDITION paragraph to two general-purpose subagents in parallel, then save both JSON outputs.
